arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Koerner argued the 1985 decision relied on broad remedial clauses in federal law.
Mr. Gardephe stated IDEA authorizes tuition reimbursement when a child is denied a proper public education.
Mr. Garre contended the district cannot refuse both a proper public placement and private tuition payment.
Mr. Koerner clarified the law is a funding grant, not a constitutional requirement.
